passages.snippet: CVE-2021-44228 (Published: 2021-12-10): Apache Log4j2 JNDI features used in configuration, log messages, and parameters do not protect against attacker controlled LDAP and other JNDI related endpoints.

MITRE ATT&CK: Spearphishing Attachment
Adversaries may send spearphishing emails with a malicious attachment in an attempt to gain access to victim systems.

CISA KEV CVE-2021-44228: Apache Log4j
Log4j deserialization vulnerability allows unauthenticated remote code execution.
